profile.name: Omkar Khandalkar
profile.summary: Omkar designs clear, accessible interfaces for complex products and can collaborate closely with engineers to bring those ideas to life.

education.title: B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
education.institution: Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Mumbai University

experience.title: Product design and UI/UX work
experience.details: Experience working on EdTech products, particularly LMS and CMS products, including Quantum LMS/CMS at Zeus Learning. Work includes complex enterprise workflows, responsive interfaces, design systems, accessibility, and collaboration with developers, QA, product managers, and stakeholders.

experience.title: Accessibility and design systems
experience.details: Worked on WCAG-aware interfaces and style-guide/design-system work to improve consistency and development efficiency.

experience.title: CodeOS community
experience.details: Created or was involved in CodeOS, a technology community focused on learning, interviews, workshops, and mentoring. Mentored students and conducted technical learning activities.

projects.title: Quantum LMS/CMS
projects.details: Major product experience in EdTech, focused on LMS/CMS workflows and complex product environments.

projects.title: AccessIQ WCAG Summariser
projects.details: An accessibility-focused project that translates WCAG issues into language teams can act on.

projects.title: MAI Labs Company Website
projects.details: A frontend and website project involving responsive, performant implementation.

projects.title: Clio AI Investment Assistant
projects.details: A product design case study about making dense financial data more approachable through progressive disclosure.

projects.title: Tryfit Shopping App
projects.details: A shopping experience focused on reducing size uncertainty and making fit decisions clearer.

philosophy: Make complex products easier to understand.
Treat accessibility as part of product quality, not an afterthought.
Use systems and collaboration to make good design consistent and buildable.
Stay curious about people, technology, and the details that shape an experience.
community_and_content: CodeOS workshops, mentoring, and learning activities.
Photography, podcasting, and vlogging as creative interests.

faq.question: What does Omkar do?
faq.answer: Omkar is a Product Designer / UI Designer who works on clear, accessible interfaces for complex products, especially EdTech LMS/CMS experiences.

faq.question: What is Omkar's experience with accessibility?
faq.answer: He has worked with WCAG considerations and accessibility-focused product work, including the AccessIQ project, and treats accessibility as part of product quality.

faq.question: What did Omkar study?
faq.answer: He studied Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering at Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology, Mumbai University.
